relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a boy with a GFAP variant: "the patient had a heterozygous deletion of genomic sequence 1247-1249GGG>GG in exon 8 of the GFAP gene".
method_note: Read by hand; a short script only assembled the JSON. One first-hand patient (label 'patient', rule 5). One previously published person in the Discussion (Shiihara et al. [7], 'ref [7] patient') is included under the v4 passing-mention rule because the text gives individual-level features (frontal lobe abnormalities, brainstem lesion, brain atrophy, no cysts on early MRI); his diagnosis label is quoted from the reference-list title, and the sentence about cysts ('Unlike our case, cyst formation was not seen in early MRI like in their case.') is awkwardly worded, read as: no cysts in their early MRI. Other cited works (refs 3-6) give no individual-level facts and get no rows. Variant: printed only as '1247-1249GGG>GG' (described as a 'deletion of genomic sequence', exon 8), with no c./p./g. prefix or transcript; cDNA, protein and genomic fields left null and variant type 'not reported' (the paper says 'deletion' only, without a class). No parental testing reported; 'no family history of neurological disorder'. The mother is mentioned only for consent and gets no row. Periventricular rim: absent at 1 year ('four of the five criteria ... except for a periventricular rim were seen at 1 year of age'), present at 4 years; this is a change over time, not a contradiction, so the checklist item is 'observed'. Spastic quadriplegia recorded as spasticity; limb weakness left 'not reported' because weakness is not named. Dyspnea not mapped to autonomic dysfunction. Onset age is given only as 'Infantile-onset' (title); referral at 12 months. Age at last evaluation is the last dated time point (5 years 4 months). No contradictions found.
